description: Everything ChatGPT workflows for Codex: shared skills, MCP configs, TDD, security scanning, code review, memory, and autonomous development.

interface.shortDescription: ChatGPT-first skills and MCP workflows for TDD, security, code review, memory, and autonomous development.
interface.longDescription: Everything ChatGPT is a ChatGPT- and Codex-first adaptation of the Everything Claude Code harness. It packages reusable skills, MCP configs, TDD workflows, security scanning, code review, architecture decisions, operator workflows, memory, and release gates in one installable plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use the tdd-workflow skill to write tests before implementation.
Use the security-review skill to scan for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
Use the verification-loop skill to verify correctness before shipping changes.
Use ChatGPT and Codex tools when available, and state clearly when a capability requires an external app or connector.
